title: A man attacks a politician in Australia – level 1
paragraphs: An Australian politician named Helen Haines is badly hurt. A man in a car attacks her outside her office. She loses a leg in the hospital.
The driver hits her on purpose.  A local barber helps stop the driver. Police catch him. He is 43 years old. Australian leaders are very sad and shocked.
Haines is a kind person who works hard for her area. Australian Prime Minister asks people to stop using bad and angry words in politics. Many people wish Haines to get well soon.
